index.bioOmar: Clinical psychologist, psychoanalyst, and interdisciplinary creator with a career oriented towards the exploration of the psyche, symbolic language, and manifestations of the unconscious. Throughout his experience, he has developed his own approach that integrates the analysis of traditional tales, the study of archetypes, and the symbolic and narrative interpretation of dreams as privileged ways to understand the human experience.
index.missionDescription: Our mission is to accompany people in understanding their dreams and their inner world through deep psychology and symbolic language.
index.visionDescription: Our vision is to be a benchmark in the study of dreams, symbols, and self-knowledge, integrating psychology, art, and exploration of the inner world.

methodology.title: Methodology
methodology.p-1: At Aurora Onírica, we believe that dreams are a bridge between consciousness and the soul.
methodology.p-2: Each symbol is a door, each image is a story, each dream scenario is a mirror.

index.purpose: Our purpose is to accompany you in the discovery of your inner world so that, by knowing yourself deeply, you find clarity, transformation and a more authentic sense of your path.

services.title: Our Services
services.p-1: Each space is designed so that people can clearly see what their inner world wants to express.
services.price: Schedules, duration, and prices are sent privately according to requirements.
services.point-1: 🌙 You feel that your dreams bring important messages.
services.point-2: 🔄 You are in a moment of change, crisis, or search.
services.point-3: 🗝️ You are interested in symbolism, fairy tales, or deep psychology.
services.point-4: 🪞 You want to better understand your inner world.
services.point-5: 🎓 You are a psychology student or therapist.
services.point-6: 🎨 You are a creator, artist, or writer looking for inspiration.
services.point-7: 🔮 You wish to connect with your intuition, your unconscious, and your personal history.

individual.title: Individual
individual.description: An intimate and deep experience where we explore your dreams, symbols, and internal movements from deep psychology. In this space, we guide you to recognize the archetypal forces operating from your unconscious, revealing what your soul already knows but your consciousness has not yet heard.
individual.paragraph_2: Each session is a bridge between your inner world and your daily reality: what you discover inside aligns with real transformations outside. Here we accompany your process from metaphor, the symbolic, and dream language, so you can move towards a more conscious and authentic version of yourself.
individual.differential: A unique symbolic-psychological approach that integrates dreams, fantasies, archetypes, and internal narratives to activate real changes in daily life. Your dream guides the process, and your life actively responds.

couple.title: Couples
couple.description: A safe space where each member of the couple listens not only to the other but also to their own inner world; through dreams, symbols, and becoming aware of the psychological projections that the couple mutually makes on each other. We accompany this process to discover the hidden dynamics that influence the bond: that which is not said but is dreamed; that which is not named but is repeated.
couple.paragraph_2: From deep psychology, we help couples transform wounds, patterns, and tensions through a more honest, compassionate, and conscious understanding of the path together.
couple.differential: A symbolic approach that reveals the unconscious mythology of the couple. What each person works on internally is reflected in the bond, generating real changes in the relationship.

conferences.title: Deep Conferences
conferences.description: Inspiring and revitalizing talks where dreams, archetypes, and psychic life are presented as fundamental scenarios for understanding the human experience. Each conference transforms how the audience understands their internal processes, showing how the symbolic and the dreamlike shape daily reality.
conferences.differential: Powerful narratives that connect science, poetry, art, and spirituality with practical examples connected to the social phenomena of the era. The audience walks away with clarity, motivation, and a new look at themselves.

workshops.title: Workshops
workshops.description: Experiential encounters where the world of dreams comes to life as a creative, psychological, spiritual, and transforming tool. Here we guide participants to explore personal and collective psychological complexes.
workshops.paragraph_2: Each workshop is designed to provoke an awakening: what you discover in your inner world allows you to act with greater clarity, personal power, and coherence to interact with your outer reality.
workshops.differential: Unique methodologies based on deep psychology, art, symbolism, and experiential dynamics. Aurora Onírica's workshops move psychic energy so that transformation is a fact from within and a manifestation in each person's interpersonal relationships.

webinars.title: Masterclass Webinars
webinars.description: Informative, intensive, and deeply revealing online spaces. We focus on teaching how to actively relate to our dreams, understand archetypes, and work with the unconscious, applicable to the events of people's daily lives.
webinars.paragraph_2: What you learn allows you to understand your inner world with a new language, unlock personal processes, and trigger changes in your outer reality.
webinars.paragraph_3: We use creative imagination so that knowledge is embodied from the depths of being, granting a new reality to your life.
webinars.differential: Clear, deep, and applicable content, guided from dream thought and symbolic psychology. You don't just learn: you transform.

consulting.title: Specialized Consultations
consulting.description: Personalized support for creators, therapists, artists, psychologists, and entrepreneurs who need to integrate a symbolic and dreamlike look into their projects or processes.
consulting.paragraph_2: We study and explore your ideas, your purpose, and your vision, understanding that there are internal forces that guide you and facilitate your path when accompanying you, or on the contrary, block you. Always! There are internal forces that accompany you. We help you align your psychic world with your external goals.
consulting.differential: A consultation that goes beyond the technical: we work with your unconscious world so that your project has soul, coherence, and integral reality. That is, connection and correspondence between your interior and your exterior.

encounters.title: Creative Encounters
encounters.description: Experiential encounters where we combine the power of active imagination, creativity, the adventure of art, the depth of the symbolic, and the exploration of your internal landscapes. Here, psychic characters, dream scenarios, powerful allies, and symbolic narratives that reveal your personal mythology are created.
encounters.paragraph_2: The creative process becomes therapy: what emerges in the artwork is a message from the soul that transforms your life outside.
encounters.differential: We integrate art, deep psychology, dreams, and creativity as a path of self-knowledge. A laboratory of images, sensations, and affects where the inner world expresses itself to reorder your outer life.

creadoresOniricos.p-1: Aurora Onírica is a space dedicated to the exploration of the inner world through the understanding of dreams, symbols, and narratives that emerge from the unconscious. From a psychological, artistic, and deeply human perspective, we accompany each person in the process of discovering new meanings, expanding self-knowledge, and strengthening their connection with themselves.
creadoresOniricos.p-2: More than an office, it is a meeting place with one's own history.

bioOmar.p-1: Clinical psychologist, psychoanalyst, and interdisciplinary creator with a career oriented towards the exploration of the psyche, symbolic language, and manifestations of the unconscious. Throughout his experience, he has developed his own approach that integrates the analysis of traditional tales, the study of archetypes, and the symbolic and narrative interpretation of dreams as privileged ways to understand the human experience.
bioOmar.p-2: His therapeutic work is based on attentive listening, deep understanding of symbols, and respect for the uniqueness of each personal story. From this perspective, dreams are not understood as prophetic messages or predictions of the future, but as meaningful expressions of the unconscious that offer guidance on the conflicts, challenges, and possibilities present in each person's life.

mission.title: Mission
mission.p-1: To accompany people in understanding their dreams and their inner world through deep psychology and symbolic language.
mission.p-2: Our mission is to facilitate processes of self-knowledge and provide tools that promote clarity, transformation, and connection with one's own essence.

vision.title: Vision
vision.p-1: To be a benchmark in the study of dreams, symbols, and self-knowledge, integrating psychology, art, and exploration of the inner world.
vision.p-2: We aspire to build a community that finds in dreams a way to understand themselves, grow, and give meaning to their life experience.

philosophy.title: Philosophy and Approach
philosophy.p-1: At Aurora Onírica, we believe that dreams are a bridge between consciousness and the soul. Each symbol is a door, each image is a story, each dream scenario is a mirror.
philosophy.p-2: Each dream shows the way; our work is to help you enter into a dynamic, brave, expansive, and integrative relationship that will unify your external reality and your inner reality.

points.subtitle: Our philosophy is based on
points.3: 🃏 Tarot as a tool for contemplation and projection of the personal unconscious.
points.4: 📖 Personal narrative as a path of transformation.
points.5: 🗣️ The art of listening, dialoguing, understanding, and relating to the living forces of the inner world.
